name: jeb
description: Jeb's link to the Jeb desktop app: watches your sessions without changing anything and keeps the farm and the anonymous live records the desktop shows

creativity.title: Creative drops
creativity.description: Three times each weekday (9:00, 12:00 and 15:00, Monday to Friday) Jeb gets a small surprise: a happening, a saying, a bit of decor or an almanac line, and over the days longer stories and pictures. Claude Haiku writes them (at most six short calls a day) from Jeb's own farm and his past surprises only, never anything from your work, prompts, code, files or tickets. Off, or with no model, Jeb writes them himself.

talk.title: How much Jeb talks
talk.description: chatty: every line Jeb has. ambient: a line on a busy stretch at most every ten minutes, plus the first line of a turn, deliveries, harvests, refused commands and test verdicts after a failure. silent: the bubble keeps its last line. Jeb also hushes while Claude writes a long answer and for five minutes after a failed test or lint run.

hookReactions.title: Hook reactions
hookReactions.description: Let Jeb react to a resumed or forked session, a settings hook refusing a command, subagents and teammates stopping, and compaction. Off by default: where a security plugin runs ahead of Jeb these hooks are skipped and Claude Code notes it on every load.
